segments.sn55.24:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena saraṇāni [sarakāni (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] sakko kālaṅkato hoti.
segments.sn55.24:1.5: Tatra sudaṃ sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti –
segments.sn55.24:1.7: Ettha dāni ko na sotāpanno bhavissati!
segments.sn55.24:1.8: Yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato;
segments.sn55.24:2.1: Atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn55.24:2.5: Tatra sudaṃ, bhante, sambahulā sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti –
segments.sn55.24:2.7: Ettha dāni ko na sotapanno bhavissati!
segments.sn55.24:2.8: Yatra hi nāma saraṇāni sakko kālaṅkato;
segments.sn55.24:3.1: “Yo so, mahānāma, dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato, so kathaṃ vinipātaṃ gaccheyya!
segments.sn55.24:3.2: Yañhi taṃ, mahānāma, sammā vadamāno vadeyya –
segments.sn55.24:3.3: ‘dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato’ti, saraṇāni sakkaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya.
segments.sn55.24:3.4: Saraṇāni, mahānāma, sakko dīgharattaṃ upāsako buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato.
segments.sn55.24:4.1: “Idha, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.24:4.3: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … hāsapañño javanapañño vimuttiyā ca samannāgato.
segments.sn55.24:4.6: So āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.sn55.24:4.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.24:5.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.24:5.3: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … hāsapañño javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
segments.sn55.24:5.6: So pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā [asmā (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] lokā.
segments.sn55.24:5.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.24:6.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.24:6.3: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
segments.sn55.24:6.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmī hoti, sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti.
segments.sn55.24:6.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.24:7.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti;
segments.sn55.24:7.3: dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
segments.sn55.24:7.6: So tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇoti.
segments.sn55.24:7.7: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pettivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā.
segments.sn55.24:8.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti … na dhamme … pe … na saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato.
segments.sn55.24:8.5: Api cassa ime dhammā honti – saddhindriyaṃ, vīriyindriyaṃ, satindriyaṃ, samādhindriyaṃ, paññindriyaṃ.
segments.sn55.24:8.7: Tathāgatappaveditā cassa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti.
segments.sn55.24:8.8: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ agantā tiracchānayoniṃ agantā pettivisayaṃ agantā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ.
segments.sn55.24:9.1: “Idha pana, mahānāma, ekacco puggalo na heva kho buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti … na dhamme … pe … na saṅghe … pe … na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato, api cassa ime dhammā honti saddhindriyaṃ … pe … paññindriyaṃ.
segments.sn55.24:9.8: Ayampi kho, mahānāma, puggalo agantā nirayaṃ agantā tiracchānayoniṃ agantā pettivisayaṃ agantā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ.
segments.sn55.24:9.9: Ime cepi, mahānāma, mahāsālā subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitaṃ ājāneyyuṃ, ime cāhaṃ [imevāhaṃ (syā. kaṃ.), imesāhaṃ (ka.)] mahāsāle byākareyyaṃ – ‘sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā’ti;
segments.sn55.24:9.10: kimaṅgaṃ [kimaṅga (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] pana saraṇāniṃ sakkaṃ.
segments.sn55.24:9.11: Saraṇāni, mahānāma, sakko maraṇakāle sikkhaṃ samādiyī”ti.

lines: Catutthe idha mahānāma ekacco puggaloti idaṃ na kevalaṃ saraṇāni eva apāyato mutto, imepi puggalā muttāti dassetuṃ āraddhaṃ.
Mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamantīti pamāṇena ca olokanaṃ khamanti.
Agantā nirayanti maggaṭṭhapuggalo hi apāyato parimuttoti vā parimuccissatīti vā vattuṃ na vaṭṭati, parimuccatīti pana vattuṃ vaṭṭati.
Yasmā ca parimuccati, tasmā gantā nāma na hotīti,“agantā”ti vutto, na gacchatīti attho.
Mahāsālāti samīpe ṭhiteva cattāro mahāsārarukkhe dassento āha.
Maraṇakāle sikkhaṃ samādiyīti maraṇasamaye tīsu sikkhāsu paripūrakārī ahosīti dasseti.
Olokanaṃ khamantīti dassanamaggena catusaccadhammā paccattaṃ passitabbā paṭivijjhitabbā.
Paṭhamamaggakkhaṇe hi catusaccadhammā ekadesatova diṭṭhā nāma honti.
“yo koci viññujātiko mama ce gocaraṃ gacchati, ekassa āgamanaṃ avañjhaṃ amoghan”ti dassetuṃ.
